title: When the Detention Wakes
author: Gideon Dravenmoor
blurb: Orsen Underhill, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
